meta.title: Cookies & Storage
meta.summary: This page lists the cookies and browser storage the Orqanix website and web app use, why each one is needed, how long it lasts and how to clear it.

blocks.text: In short

Our marketing and legal pages set no cookies. The only things they may store are your choices: the language, the light or dark look, and the US or EU version of our legal pages, each only after you click. Cookies appear only on the sign-in pages and in the web app, because sign-in cannot work without them. We use no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies.
Cookies and storage

A cookie is a small text file a website saves in your browser. Your browser sends it back on later visits. Local storage and session storage are similar places in your browser where a website can keep small pieces of information. Local storage keeps them until they are cleared; session storage keeps them until you close the tab. This page covers all three, on orqanix.com and in the Orqanix web app.

blocks.text: When you sign up, Cloudflare Turnstile also runs a short check in your browser to confirm you are a person and not a bot. It is part of sign-in and runs for Clerk.
Where each applies
Marketing and legal pages

The home page, the product pages and these legal pages load no sign-in code, set no cookies and make no calls to other companies. Their fonts come from our own server. The only items they may store are your language, look and region choices, each only after you click. Our host, Google Cloud, keeps normal server logs of each visit (IP address, browser, time and page), as our [Privacy Policy](/instant/legal/privacy#website) explains. These logs stay on the server; nothing is stored in your browser for them. If you click Download, the Desktop App comes from Google Cloud Storage, so Google sees your IP address.
Sign-in pages and the web app

The sign-in and sign-up pages and the web app load Clerk, which runs our sign-in. Clerk, and Cloudflare working for Clerk, set the sign-in cookies and storage listed in [What we store](#what-we-store). In the web app, we also store your menu layout so it looks the way you left it. If you choose Sign in with Google, Google's own pages open, and Google's cookies and terms apply there.
No cookie banner

EU and UK law let a website store or read information on your device without asking first only when this is strictly necessary to provide a service you explicitly asked for (ePrivacy Directive Art. 5(3); in Germany, § 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG; in the UK, the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations). Everything we store meets that test. Your language, look and region choices are stored because you clicked for them. Sign-in needs its cookies and bot protection. The web app remembers the menu layout you set. We use nothing for advertising, analytics or tracking, so there is nothing to ask your consent for, and no banner.
If we ever want to use storage that is not strictly necessary, we will ask for your consent first and update this page.
No cookie banner

Everything we store is needed for something you asked for: your region choice, signing in, protecting sign-in from bots and remembering your menu layout. We use no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies, and we let no other company track you on our site. So there is nothing to opt out of, and no banner. If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, we treat it as a request to opt out of the sale and sharing of your personal information. We do neither, so nothing changes.
If we ever want to use storage for another purpose, we will update this page first and give you the choices the law requires.
What we do not use

items: No advertising cookies or ad networks.
No analytics or tracking tools, and no tracking pixels.
No fonts or other files loaded from other companies on our marketing and legal pages.
No storage that follows you across other websites.

blocks.text: Clearing and blocking

items: You can see, delete and block cookies and site data in your browser's settings, usually under Privacy or Site data. Deleting the site data for orqanix.com and for Clerk's sign-in domain removes everything in the table.
To change your region choice, use the US / EU switch on any legal page. To remove it, clear your browser's site data for orqanix.com.
Signing out ends your sign-in session.
If you block the sign-in cookies or Cloudflare's check, you can still read our website, but signing in and the web app will not work.

blocks.text: The Desktop App

The Desktop App is not a website. It uses no cookies or storage for advertising, analytics or tracking. It keeps its data on your Mac: your chat history, settings, logs, your Orqanix sign-in (in the macOS Keychain) and small items in the app's own built-in storage, such as your theme, menu layout, pinned chats and a list of messages you recently typed. Our [Privacy Policy](/instant/legal/privacy#desktop-app) explains what stays on your Mac and what leaves it.
Changes
When what we store changes, we update this page and the date at the top. Questions: {company.privacyEmail}.
